texts.preamble: M/S. R.K. Traders vs The Government Of Telangana on 30 March, 2021 Author: Hima Kohli Bench: Hima Kohli, B.Vijaysen Reddy Item No.28 The Hon'Ble The Chief Justice Hima Kohli And The Hon'Ble Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy Writ Petition No.1338 of 2021 Order:
texts.arguments: The petitioners have filed the present petition challenging a Notification dated 06.01.2021 issued by the respondents/State under Section 30 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 which bans all chewing/chewable tobacco products, claiming that the same is contrary to the Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003. 2. Learned counsel for the respondents/State submits that the issue raised in the present petition is pending consideration before the Supreme Court in Transfer Case (Civil) No.1 of 2010 wherein, all the States including the State of Telangana is represented.

Learned counsel for the respondents/State submits that the issue raised in the present petition is pending consideration before the Supreme Court in Transfer Case (Civil) No.1 of 2010 wherein, all the States including the State of Telangana is represented.
